verdict.rationale: Render explicitly offers 'ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change' and single-YAML architecture definitions (Blueprints), which supports spinning up isolated preview environments for parallel team work; community also praises its docker-compose-like IaC approach. However, there's no explicit evidence of 'unlimited' environments, per-team concurrency limits, or team-scale collaboration workflows, and one community note cites past outages that could affect reliability at scale. Missing for 10: explicit unlimited/no-limit language, team collaboration/multi-user workflow details, and independent verification of concurrent environment scaling.
